* Partner with product, UX, analysts and subject matter experts to define useful model behavior.
* Document experiments and decisions so teammates can retrain, evaluate and maintain models.

Requirements:

* 3+ years of hands-on neural network training or fine-tuning.

Responsibilities

About the Team Detection Engineering is part of Content Assurance and is aligned with USDS JV Security & Privacy. The team provides product-independent technical assurance for recommender and generative AI systems, testing whether system behavior remains within declared safety, quality, and governance boundaries before and after release. AI Assurance Engineering builds and operates shared evaluation infrastructure, including test harnesses, benchmark pipelines, replay systems, adversarial-testing tools, safety-metric telemetry, and assurance CI/CD. The team is independent from the product teams whose models it evaluates. About the Role As an AI Assurance Engineer, you will design rigorous evaluation methods and production-quality capabilities for measuring and diagnosing recommender and generative AI behavior. You will develop benchmark datasets, define reproducible test protocols, implement safety, quality, robustness, and drift metrics, and investigate behavioral regressions through adversarial testing and counterfactual replay. This role focuses on evaluation engineering and technical assurance, not product model training, policy setting, moderation, or release ownership.
